title: code-tidying team config
description: Schema for <home>/code-tidying.yaml, the team layer of the code-tidying plugin's upkeep settings. Keys and resolution: plugins/code-tidying/reference/config.md.

upkeep_cadence.description: How often an upkeep batch may open pull requests.

upkeep_backstop.description: An area with no upkeep sweep inside this window is overdue, with or without churn.

upkeep_max_open.description: At most this many chore/tidy-* pull requests open at once: /code-tidying:tidy stops at it, and an upkeep batch opens only the difference.
